item.title: After Transmigrating, I and the Female Lead Both Found It 'Really Fragrant' (GL) — Chapter 85
item.description: ...But thankfully, my senior sister peeked into my inner world, otherwise I would have died a thousand deaths. Next, the classroom, the nightmare realm, the monster's lair, the desert temple... As the scenes changed one after another, the colors became more and more vibrant, as if transitioning from a gloomy winter to the warm spring…
